dev.description: Run desktop app serving built frontend/dist

tasks.package:linux: deno task build:frontend && mkdir -p dist/linux && deno desktop -A --backend=webview --compress=xz --include=./frontend/dist --include=./icons --output=./dist/linux/excalidraw-offline ./desktop/main.ts
tasks.package:appimage: deno task build:frontend && mkdir -p dist/linux && deno desktop -A --backend=webview --compress=xz --include=./frontend/dist --include=./icons --output=./dist/linux/excalidraw-offline.AppImage ./desktop/main.ts
tasks.test:file-format: deno test -A desktop/file-format_test.ts desktop/path_test.ts desktop/dialogs_test.ts desktop/close-guard_test.ts
